title: The Celebration Held on the Wrong Day
central_conflict: half the town arrived for a holiday feast while the tables were still being built
decisive_choice: the invitation printer had mixed day-month and month-day date formats
resolution: sent corrected invitations with the month written out and held one shared feast
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered half the town arrived for a holiday feast while the tables were still being built before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they reread the invitations but each group insisted its date was correct; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the invitation printer had mixed day-month and month-day date formats; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the visiting readers watching, they sent corrected invitations with the month written out and held one shared feast, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Stage That Leaned During the Dance
central_conflict: the floating festival stage tilted whenever the performers gathered
decisive_choice: the equipment and audience had all been placed on the same side of the pontoons
resolution: closed the stage for a balanced-load inspection and reopened after a safe test
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the floating festival stage tilted whenever the performers gathered before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they tightened the stage ropes but it leaned further with every dancer; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the equipment and audience had all been placed on the same side of the pontoons; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the visiting readers watching, they closed the stage for a balanced-load inspection and reopened after a safe test, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Stars That Would Not Stay Sharp
central_conflict: the observatory telescope showed trembling stars despite a clear sky
decisive_choice: warm air from a roof exhaust vent crossed the telescope's line of sight
resolution: redirected the warm exhaust away from the viewing slit and checked the stars again
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the observatory telescope showed trembling stars despite a clear sky before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they cleaned the lens and refocused it but the stars kept wobbling; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized warm air from a roof exhaust vent crossed the telescope's line of sight; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the visiting readers watching, they redirected the warm exhaust away from the viewing slit and checked the stars again, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
